record.question: The punishment for an attempt to commit suicide is:
options: Simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year or with fine or with both.
Imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or with fine or both
Simple imprisonment for three months or with fine or both
Imprisonment for one month with fine.
record.explanation: Attempt to commit suicide is punishable with simple imprisonment up to one year.
